title: Real-Time Sales & Customer Analytics Dashboard
description: Interactive dashboard combining Python, HTML, APIs, and Google Sheets to visualize customer behavior, product performance, regional trends, and real-time sales metrics. Processes 10,000+ customer records with live data refresh.
impact: Reduced reporting time by 70% and enabled daily decision-making for 3 business units.

title: Customer Segmentation & Behavior Analysis
description: Data pipeline that segments customers by purchase behavior, demographics, and regional patterns. Built with Python and integrated directly into Google Sheets for non-technical stakeholders.
impact: Identified 4 key customer segments, improving targeted marketing ROI by 35%.

title: Inventory & Stock Management Dashboard
description: Real-time inventory tracking system built on Odoo data, providing live stock levels, reorder alerts, and supplier performance metrics through an interactive web dashboard.
impact: Eliminated stockouts by 60% and reduced excess inventory holding costs.

title: Regional Sales Performance Tracker
description: Multi-region sales performance dashboard with drill-down capabilities. Maps sales by region, tracks KPIs against targets, and generates automated weekly performance reports.
impact: Enabled regional managers to identify underperformance 2 weeks earlier on average.

title: Loyalty Program Analytics Platform
description: End-to-end loyalty program dashboard tracking member enrollment, point redemption, tier progression, and churn prediction. Integrates with POS data for real-time updates.
impact: Increased loyalty program engagement by 28% through data-driven reward optimization.

title: Gender-Based Product Performance Analysis
description: Comprehensive analysis of product performance segmented by customer gender, purchase frequency, and basket size. Produces automated reports with actionable merchandising recommendations.
impact: Informed product category decisions that increased average basket value by 18%.
